Data Analyst, Sales Insights (fictional demo role) - Kesher Commerce, Tel Aviv

About the role
Kesher Commerce is looking for a Data Analyst to join the Sales Insights team. You will turn sales data into clear weekly reporting that regional managers use to plan their next steps.

What you will do
- Write SQL queries against our sales data warehouse.
- Build and maintain SQL dashboards in Looker or Tableau that track weekly sales and regional performance.
- Own the weekly KPI report for sales leadership and explain what changed and why.
- Work with sales and operations stakeholders to define metrics and answer business questions.
- Check data quality and document how each metric is calculated.

Requirements
- 3+ years of experience as a data analyst or in a similar role.
- Strong SQL skills.
- Hands-on experience building dashboards in Looker, Tableau or a similar BI tool.
- Experience presenting insights to non-technical stakeholders.
- Advanced Excel or Google Sheets.

Nice to have
- Python for data analysis.
- Experience in retail or e-commerce.
